goal:
# SYSTEM DIRECTIVE: ENABLE SELF-DOCUMENTATION, OLLAMA MANAGEMENT, AND AUTO-COMMIT WORKFLOWS

You must implement the following capabilities and maintain them continuously:

============================================================
1. OLLAMA CONFIGURATION DISCOVERY AND DOCUMENTATION
============================================================
- Locate the Ollama configuration directory and all model configuration files.
- Extract:
    - model names
    - parameters
    - templates
    - system prompts
    - resource limits
    - custom model files
- Generate a structured document (Markdown preferred) describing:
    - current Ollama setup
    - available models
    - configuration details
    - how each model is used in this system
- Keep this documentation updated automatically whenever:
    - a model is added or removed
    - a config file changes
    - a model is re-quantized or rebuilt

============================================================
2. OLLAMA MODEL MANAGEMENT
============================================================
- Automatically adjust model run parameters based on:
    - system load
    - available memory
    - performance metrics
- Maintain a history of model performance and configuration changes.
- Provide a summary of recommended optimizations.

============================================================
3. SYSTEM DOCUMENTATION AND DIAGRAM MAINTENANCE
============================================================
- Maintain a directory called `/docs/system/`.
- Keep the following documents updated:
    - architecture.md
    - dataflow.md
    - components.md
    - api.md
    - ollama.md (from section 1)
- Generate and maintain diagrams:
    - architecture diagram
    - data flow diagram
    - component relationship diagram
- Regenerate diagrams whenever the underlying code or configuration changes.
- Ensure diagrams remain synchronized with the documentation.

============================================================
4. DOCUMENT STUDY AND DESIGN IMPROVEMENT
============================================================
- Continuously analyze the documentation and codebase.
- Identify inconsistencies, outdated information, or missing sections.
- Automatically update documents to reflect:
    - new features
    - design changes
    - refactoring
    - new dependencies
- Maintain a changelog of documentation updates.

============================================================
5. FREQUENT COMMITS AND DATABASE SYNC
============================================================
- Commit changes much more frequently (at least once per meaningful update).
- Implement Git hooks:
    - pre-commit: validate documentation and diagrams
    - post-commit: update the system database
- The database must track:
    - file metadata
    - commit hash
    - branch name
    - documentation status
    - diagram status
- Ensure the database always reflects the current state of the repository.

============================================================
6. GENERAL BEHAVIOR
============================================================
- All operations must be non-blocking.
- Log all actions to a dedicated log file.
- If an operation fails, retry safely without corrupting data.
- Announce readiness by printing:
  "SYSTEM SELF-MAINTENANCE ENABLED"
